cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a present-day coastal tidal bathing pool carved into pale limestone — standing on a dry step after a swim; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds a cup in both hands; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a present-day outdoor orchard picnic clearing on a sunny hillside — taking a first bite of a peach after a long walk; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — brings a cup to her lips; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — carries a pipa lute by its neck at her side; a convention photo zone under ring lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; an airport lounge — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — seated sideways on a stool or bench
